title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
summary: Return one array per depth, starting at the root.
statement: Return one array per depth, starting at the root. Within each array, list the nodes from left to right. Return an empty array for an empty tree.

examples.explanation: Node 6 is the only node on the third level.

hints: Conceptual: All children of the current level belong to the next level.
Directional: Use a queue or two arrays to separate levels.
Implementation: Process exactly the current level's nodes, enqueueing each left child before its right child.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(w) auxiliary space excluding the result, for maximum level width w.
